messages:
alice.support: FYI customer AcmeRetail hit 403s on SSO right after their IdP rotated certs. Error in auth-service log: `saml: audience mismatch: expected 'https://acme.app.redwood.example' got 'https://acme.app.redwood.example '` — looks like a trailing non-breaking space in the Issuer.

bob.eng: Can you paste the SAML Response Issuer (redacted) and the SP metadata we provided?

alice.support: Pasting redacted excerpt from the SAML response we captured (removing assertions):

```
<samlp:Response ID="_abc123" IssueInstant="2024-11-08T12:34:56Z" Version="2.0">
  <saml:Issuer>https://acme.app.redwood.example </saml:Issuer>
  <!-- signature + assertions -->
</samlp:Response>
```

alice.support: Our stored SP entityID/metadata is `https://acme.app.redwood.example` (no NBSP). Customer says their IdP rotation script re-wrote metadata and may have introduced weird whitespace.

carol.sre: :eyes: NBSPs in metadata are a classic gotcha. Does our metadata fetcher canonicalize whitespace? I thought we trimmed normal spaces but maybe not NBSP (U+00A0).

bob.eng: I dug into the metadata parsing code — we call `.trim()` on the Issuer string which only removes ASCII whitespace, not NBSP. We recently changed XML parser to preserve original text nodes for audit, so normalization got stricter in last deploy. That makes old cached entries tolerate it but new responses fail.

alice.support: Repro steps from customer: 1) IdP rotated cert via admin UI -> rotation job writes new metadata XML back to metadata endpoint. 2) User clicks "Sign in" -> SP receives SAML Response with Issuer containing NBSP. 3) SP returns 403 with audience mismatch.

bob.eng: Quick mitigation: update metadata cache to accept both forms (strip NBSP on compare) and push a small hotfix to normalize Issuer on intake. I can open a patch now.

carol.sre: Also recommend invalidating cached metadata for that customer (TTL workaround) and trigger a metadata re-fetch after we fix parsing.

alice.support: Customer is blocked, requesting ETA. They said peak is now.

bob.eng: I'll cut a patch and roll to canary in prod. If it passes, I'll rollout cluster-wide. ETA ~25m to canary, 45m full if no regressions.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: patch/normalize-issuer-nbsp deployed to canary (build 2024.11.08-774).

carol.sre: After deploy, please run an auth flow test against Acme's IdP (we have their test org) and paste the new logs.

bob.eng: Canary logs: `saml: audience match ok for 'https://acme.app.redwood.example' (normalized from 'https://acme.app.redwood.example ')` — test login succeeded. Rolling forward now. :white_check_mark:

alice.support: Customer confirmed they can sign in now. They said their rotation script will be updated but asked if we can be lenient on whitespace for a few weeks.

carol.sre: Follow-up actions: 1) Add canonicalization for NBSP and similar unicode whitespace to metadata normalization. 2) Update docs for SSO onboarding warning about non-ASCII whitespace. 3) Add a sanity check during metadata ingestion to surface invisible chars in the Console.

bob.eng: I'll open two PRs: one for hotfix (backported) and one for improved normalization + tests.

alice.support: Thanks all — closing the support ticket after confirm. :thumbsup:
